description: Java framework for REST servers on Jakarta JAX-RS (Jersey, Grizzly) and MongoDB: annotated entities with CRUD, JWT security, validation, migrations, indexes, and TypeScript/Python/OpenAPI client generation.
rules: Register GenericCatcher.addAll(rc) and ContextGenericTools.addJsr310(rc) in the launcher; without addJsr310 @ValidGroup is silently ignored and the date format changes.
@ValidGroup does not check the Default group: also put @Valid on the parameter and register Jersey's ValidationFeature.
AuthenticationFilter answers 403 to any endpoint without @PermitAll, @RolesAllowed or @RightAllowed; without an authentication filter, @RolesAllowed is ignored.
JWT: the subject must be an ObjectId, the default issuer is "Karso", roles and rights are PartRight codes (int 0-3 or name), never Boolean.
createdAt and updatedAt carry @DataNotRead and are not returned by default reads: use the ReadAllColumn option.

Entity mapping uses archidata annotations (org.atriasoft.archidata.annotation): @Collection, @Field, @Id, @InitValue. JPA annotations (jakarta.persistence) and JAX-RS @DefaultValue on an entity field are ignored.
Unicity needs a unique index: declare @Indexed(unique = true) or @Index and call IndexEngine.synchronize() at startup; @Field only renames a field.
updateById without a FilterValue rewrites every editable field, null included: pass the field list for a partial update.
MigrationEngine stores its history in KAR_migration; an empty database only runs the init; an unknown last migration name throws MigrationException; revert is unsupported.
archidata brings no SLF4J backend (its logback is test-scoped on purpose): the application must declare logback-classic.
Change streams need a replica set; only the FullDocument mode given to start() counts (per-listener mode is deprecated and ignored); listeners run on the worker thread; stop() clears listeners.
CronScheduler uses Unix (Vixie) syntax, numeric only (no MON, @daily, L, W, #); one consumer thread, no catch-up of missed runs, one scheduler per process (see doc/cron.md).
ConfigBaseVariable reads the environment when the class loads; getDBPassword() throws if DB_PASSWORD is missing.
Relation fields (@ManyToOneDoc, @OneToManyDoc, @ManyToManyDoc) support ObjectId, Long and UUID keys; any other type, such as String, is rejected naming the class and field. UUID primary keys work.
JSON errors: GenericCatcher.addAll registers RequestBodyReaderInterceptor and RequestBodyExceptionCatcher, so a bad request body gives 400; any other raw JacksonException gives 500.
Use new FailException(Response.Status.X, message) for an error with a precise HTTP status; the one-argument constructor gives 400.
Compile the application with -parameters, otherwise validation errors name the arguments arg0, arg1.
Read META-INF/archidata/llms-full.txt in the archidata jar of ~/.m2 matching the project's version: it is the documentation of that exact version.
